title: A Deep Generative Model for Synthesizing Labeled Wireless Signals
abstract: arXiv:2609.05396v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wireless signals with position-related labels are pivotal for both performance evaluation and model training in the realm of wireless sensing. However, acquiring real-world datasets is often challenged by significant measurement and labeling costs. Traditional methods for synthesizing labeled wireless signals typically rely on environmental models, leading to extensive hyper-parameter tuning and inadequate realism for comprehensive model training purposes. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel deep learning (DL)-based method, namely Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks (IIns-GAN), to generate realistic labeled wireless signals. The generated signals are particularly adaptive to different environment scenarios and well-suited for various model training tasks, including distance estimation and environment identification. translated_title: 一种用于合成带标签无线信号的深度生成模型
translated_abstract: 带有位置相关标签的无线信号对于无线感知领域的性能评估和模型训练都至关重要。然而，获取真实世界的数据集往往面临巨大的测量和标注成本。传统的合成带标签无线信号的方法通常依赖于环境模型，这导致需要大量的超参数调优，并且在用于全面模型训练方面真实感不足。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的基于深度学习（DL）的方法，即实例间生成对抗网络，用于生成逼真的带标签无线信号。所生成的信号对不同环境场景具有很强的适应性，非常适合各种模型训练任务，包括距离估计和环境识别。我们在公开的超宽带（UWB）数据集上进行了广泛的实验来评估该方法的性能。
tldr: 提出了一种基于深度学习的实例间生成对抗网络（IIns-GAN），能够生成适应不同环境场景的逼真带标签无线信号，可有效用于距离估计和环境识别等模型训练任务，解决了传统方法依赖环境模型、超参数调优繁琐且真实感不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks (IIns-GAN), a deep learning-based method that generates realistic labeled wireless signals adaptive to different environment scenarios, suitable for model training tasks such as distance estimation and environment identification, overcoming the limitations of traditional environmental model-based approaches.
